sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Snake Survival is a game about survival - but not just any survival. You see, your snake has a voracious appetite, and it's always on the lookout for its next meal. The catch? The food is scattered throughout the maze, and you'll need to navigate through treacherous terrain to reach it. But beware: you're not the only predator on the block. Other snakes, each with its own unique abilities and strengths, are also on the hunt. They'll stop at nothing to snatch your lunch, and it's up to you to outsmart them and emerge victorious.

The game's controls are delightfully straightforward - simply use your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to guide your snake through the maze. But don't be fooled: the game's difficulty level increases exponentially with each new game, making it a true challenge for even the most seasoned gamers. As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter increasingly complex obstacles, from spinning blades to spiky pits, each designed to put your reflexes to the test.

But the real magic happens when you start to unlock the game's various power-ups and abilities. With each new power-up, you'll gain access to new areas of the maze, as well as increased speed and agility. It's a true game-changer, and one that will give you a serious edge over your competition.
